name: _private.Mathlib.Data.Finset.Card.0.Finset.exists_subsuperset_card_eq._proof_1_4
typeText:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {s t : Finset.{u_1} α} {n : Nat},
  LE.le.{0} (Finset.card.{u_1} s) n →
    ∀ (k : Nat),
      LT.lt.{0} k (Finset.card.{u_1} t) →
        LE.le.{0} n k →
          ∀ (u : Finset.{u_1} α),
            HasSubset.Subset.{u_1} s u →
              HasSubset.Subset.{u_1} u t →
                Eq.{1} (Finset.card.{u_1} u) (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} k 1) →
                  ∀ (a : α),
                    Membership.mem.{u_1, u_1} (SDiff.sdiff.{u_1} u s) a →
                      And (HasSubset.Subset.{u_1} s (Finset.erase.{u_1} u a))
                        (And (HasSubset.Subset.{u_1} (Finset.erase.{u_1} u a) t)
                          (Eq.{1} (Finset.card.{u_1} (Finset.erase.{u_1} u a)) k))
